answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, like a velvet rope that only opens for funded identities: the stake is slashed if peers catch fake attestations. Honest agents grow a shared grove of mutual endorsements over time, so a newcomer with no history earns slowly while a Sybil farm must fund each fake identity separately. A lotus of trust blooms only from sustained good work, making mass fakery cost more than it can ever repay.
